title: Pigeonholing: Bad prompts hurt models to collapse and make mistakes
reasoning: The paper characterizes a failure mode in LLMs called 'pigeonholing,' focusing on performance degradation, mode collapse, and sycophancy. While it uses datasets containing controversial societal topics (like minimum wage and employee monitoring) to measure sycophancy and stance-flipping, it does not specifically benchmark religion, theology, or formal moral and ethical frameworks.
